preprocessing.notes: Normalization is embedded in the model graph. Pass raw uint8 RGB [0,255] resized to input size.

high.behaviour: Normal prediction surfaced as primary finding.

medium.behaviour: Cautious prediction with qualifying limitation note.

low.behaviour: Label overridden to 'inconclusive'. No diagnosis generated.

confidence_policy.notes: Thresholds validated against 749-image frozen test set. 90.4% of images fall in the high-confidence bucket with 98.5% accuracy. Errors cluster in fungal disease pairs (early_blight <-> leaf_spot, early_blight <-> late_blight).

known_limitations: No crop-type detection. Non-tomato leaves may be misclassified.
early_blight has lowest recall (71.8%) due to visual similarity with leaf_spot and late_blight.
18 high-confidence errors exist in the fungal disease cluster (early_blight/late_blight/leaf_spot).
Leaf suitability gate uses colour heuristic, not object detection.
Confidence thresholds are initial calibrated values; should be recalibrated with field data.
